title: Beo Pian
subject: a Banjarmasin man whose talking myna was meant to learn a pantun for the bird show, but only ever learned his wife's voice calling him home from the riverside coffee stall, and now shouts it at him in front of his friends
caption: Banjar panting pop from South Kalimantan with a japin dance lilt. Panting lute strummed fast and bright, babun frame drum in a skipping japin rhythm, low gong on the downbeat, a sawing violin melody doubling the hook, acoustic bass. Lively, slightly raw front-porch acoustic band sound. Bright nasal male tenor with comic spoken asides, a female voice squawking the bird's lines. 128 BPM, G major. Bouncy, cheeky and laughing. No dangdut koplo, no EDM, no trap, no autotune, no rock drum kit.
lyrics:
[Intro - panting strum, babun skips in, violin hook]

[Verse 1]
Aku beli beo di Pasar Sudimampir
Niatnya biar dia pintar berpantun
Tiap pagi aku ajari satu bait
Dia cuma miring, terus menguap

[Pre-Chorus]
Tiga bulan sabar, tiga bulan sepi
Sampai Selasa sore dia bersuara

[Chorus]
Bang, pulang Bang, nasinya dingin
Persis suara istriku di pintu
Teman di warung ketawa semua
Kopiku belum habis, Bang, pulang Bang

[Verse 2]
Aku bawa ke lomba di Siring
Juri duduk, mikrofon dinyalakan
Aku bisikkan bait yang sudah kuhafal
Dia tarik napas panjang

[Pre-Chorus]
Semua orang diam, aku berdoa
Beo itu menatap aku saja

[Chorus]
Bang, pulang Bang, nasinya dingin
Satu lapangan dengar suara istriku
Juri ketawa sampai menangis
Pialanya nggak dapat, Bang, pulang Bang

[Bridge - violin and babun, spoken]
Istriku bilang beo itu pintar
Yang bodoh yang nongkrong sampai magrib

[Outro - panting strum, one last squawk, gong]
